3.name: Abjuration Savant
3.notes:
Add two level 1–2 Abjuration Wizard spells to your spellbook for free.

Whenever you gain a new level of spell slots, add one free Abjuration Wizard spell of a level you can cast to your spellbook.

3.name: Arcane Ward
3.notes:
When you cast an Abjuration spell with a spell slot, you can create a magical ward on yourself that lasts until you finish a Long Rest.

Ward HP = 2 × your Wizard level + your Intelligence modifier.

Damage rules:
- Damage is applied to the ward instead of you.
- Apply your Resistances/Vulnerabilities before damage reduces the ward.
- If the ward drops to 0 HP, you take any remaining damage.

Restoring the ward:
- Each time you cast an Abjuration spell with a spell slot, the ward regains HP equal to 2 × the slot level.
- As a Bonus Action, you may expend a spell slot to restore the ward by the same amount.

You cannot create the ward again until finishing a Long Rest.

6.name: Projected Ward
6.notes:
When a creature you can see within 30 ft. takes damage, you may use a Reaction to have your Arcane Ward absorb that damage instead.

If this reduces the ward to 0 HP, the protected creature takes leftover damage. Apply the creature’s Resistances/Vulnerabilities before reduction.

10.name: Spell Breaker
10.notes:
You always have Counterspell and Dispel Magic prepared.

Benefits:
- You can cast Dispel Magic as a Bonus Action.
- Add your Proficiency Bonus to the Dispel Magic ability check.
- When Counterspell or Dispel Magic fails to stop a spell, the spell slot used is not expended.

14.name: Spell Resistance
14.notes:
You have Advantage on all saving throws against spells.
You also have Resistance to spell damage.
